window_ul.label: Marker observation volume after settling, µL

steps.name: Marker pass 1 / level 1
steps.confirm_message: Collection 1, channel {channel} only. Reset the marker and keep the same filled path. Wait at least {settle_s} seconds and verify stable flow before injecting. Record injection and first outlet breakthrough times relative to actual step start, not this gate. Keep injection/detection positions and the breakthrough criterion unchanged. Increase the observation volume before planning if the marker needs a longer window.
